n5je004p.zh-cn: 🔥基于 .NET 6/8 (Furion/SqlSugar) 实现的通用权限开发框架，前端采用 Vue3/Element-plus，代码简洁、易扩展。整合最新技术，模块插件式开发，前后端分离，开箱即用。集成多租户、缓存、数据校验、鉴权、事件总线、动态API、通讯、远程请求、任务调度、打印等众多黑科技。让开发更简单、更通用、更流行！
n5je004p.en: 🔥A general permission development framework based on .NET 6/8 (Furion/SqlSugar), with frontend using Vue3/Element-plus. The code is concise and easily extensible. Integrating the latest technologies, modular plugin-based development, frontend-backend separation, ready to use out of the box. Incorporates numerous advanced features such as multi-tenancy, caching, data validation, authentication, event bus, dynamic API, communication, remote requests, task scheduling, printing, and more. Making development simpler, more universal, and more popular!
